request.style: English, bright male solo voice with warm choir backing, acoustic guitar, piano, strings, light percussion, hopeful and gentle mood, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The sons of Bebai counted clear,
Six hundred twenty-three are here,
Returning home to Zion's street,
Where ancient memories beat,
Under Zerubbabel's care,
A family gathered there.

[Chorus]
We seal the covenant again,
With heads of all the people's men,
Following God's holy way,
In Jerusalem every day,
The sons of Bebai stand and sign,
The truth that is forever thine.

[Verse]
Six hundred twenty-eight are listed,
In Nehemiah's book that's witnessed,
Of Bebai's line they came to stay,
In the city of God's clay,
A new group follows Ezra's lead,
With Zechariah and his seed,
Twenty-eight men with Jahaziel's son,
The journey is not yet done.

[Chorus]
We seal the covenant again,
With heads of all the people's men,
Following God's holy way,
In Jerusalem every day,
The sons of Bebai stand and sign,
The truth that is forever thine.

[Verse]
Jehohanan and Hananiah too,
Zabbai and Athlai in view,
Foreign wives they had to send,
To keep the people pure and sound,
Ezra led the cleansing task,
In Jerusalem's sacred space,
The heads of families stood in line,
To keep the law divine.

[Chorus]
We seal the covenant again,
With heads of all the people's men,
Following God's holy way,
In Jerusalem every day,
The sons of Bebai stand and sign,
The truth that is forever thine.

[Outro]
The sons of Bebai, sealed in truth,
In Jerusalem, God's eternal youth.
